description: This file serves as the entry point for the preview build of a Qwik application using Vite. It sets up the QwikCity middleware for server-side rendering during the preview phase, importing necessary modules and configuring the middleware with render and plan.

methods.name: createQwikCity
methods.description: Creates and configures the QwikCity app with provided options, used here to set up server-side rendering middleware for Vite preview.
